notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to our first ever devlog! [/h1]

We at Black Rose Projects are working 24/7 on Dark Moonlight and would like to share our progress with you. Development of the game is going according to plan, new levels and enemies are currently being built. Stay tuned for regular updates and production highlights. A lot of dark fun ahead of us, so let's stay in touch!
